Delhi High Court Questions CJP Leaders on Legal Approach

The Delhi High Court questioned leaders of the Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP) regarding their decision to approach the court under Article 226, asking why they chose this specific legal remedy. The RSS issued a warning in relation to the CJP's movement. The coverage also briefly mentions an explanation of the Bhagwant Mann Airport Row.
